title: Coral and the Autopsy
author: Ulyana Vasquez
blurb: Jonah Almeida, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
